### Problem

A tool missing on the runner fails every plugin's pull request whose repository has translations, and the autopilot spends fix rounds without end on something its agent cannot change.

### Scope

`.github/workflows/autopilot.yml` (the pre-pr job), `scripts/autopilot.py` (how a pre-pr failure is read, when a fix round starts), the kinds' packs (the tools their pre-pr needs), their tests and docs.

### Out of scope

Any repository's `make pre-pr` or .po files. The excerpt of the failure (#679).

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a wordpress-plugin repository with .po files in the form that merges, when the pre-pr job runs, then `i18n-form` passes.
C2: Given a pre-pr log with `command not found`, when the autopilot reads it, then it reports an engine failure and starts no fix round.
C3: Given a fix round whose pre-pr fails with the same failure as the round before, when it ends, then the autopilot stops and says so on the pull request instead of starting another round.

### Criticality

Critical
